summary: A language model answers one question: which token comes next? You run a toy model that counts which token follows which, generate text with it, see it fail on an unseen word and loop, add sampling, and draw the flow from text to tokens to a model to the next token.
goal: Draw the flow from text to tokens to a model to the next token, and run a toy model that follows it.

items.text: Answer the two warm-up questions from memory, then guess the hook
Step 1: run the toy model and find the three stages: tokens and ids, the model, the loop
Step 2: start from sensor instead of the, predict the generated line, then check
Step 3: ask for the token after battery and read the IndexError, then generate 12 tokens and see the loop
Step 4: add sampling with a fixed seed, and draw the flow from text to the next token on paper
Play the Token Path game to the end and see your score
